spans.s:
(ङ) धृङ् r. 1st cl. (धरते)
To fall.
r. 6th cl. (ध्रियते)
1 To continue, to remain.
2 To have or hold.
(ञ) धृञ् r. 1st cl. (धरति-ते)
To have or hold, to keep, to maintain.
r. 1st cl. (धरति)
To sprinkle.
r. 10th cl. (धारयति)
To hold.
With अप or निर् prefixed,
To verify, to make sure or certain.

r. 9th cl. (धृणाति^1)
To be or grow old.
[1] Correction submitted by SergeA on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batche 313. note: cf. WIL1819 or MW.
